name: Textured-GS
aliases: Gaussian Splatting with Spatially Defined Color and Opacity
definition: A rendering method that enhances the textural representation of individual 3D Gaussians by modeling spatially defined color and opacity variations across the Gaussian ellipsoidal surface using Spherical Harmonics (SH), without increasing the number of Gaussians or adding extra parameters beyond the existing SH framework.
summary: Textured-GS enhances 3D Gaussian Splatting by modeling spatially varying color and opacity across each Gaussian's surface using Spherical Harmonics evaluated at intersection points rather than viewing directions.
